<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to an SN2 substitution where a halide (e.g., Cl) is displaced by a nucleophile forming a C‑N bond. We'll search the template catalog for templates that break a halide functional group and form an amine (or more generally a nitrogen nucleophile) bond. We'll use the provided molecule SMILES as the target and filter by functional_groups_broken = ["halide"] and functional_groups_formed = ["amine"]. Then we can inspect the returned templates and pick one that matches, returning its mapped_rxn and template_id.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amine"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
